Proof in the paper: The X-ray diffraction (XRD) results show that the diffraction peak located at 44.2° can be assigned to (111) lattice planes of FeNi3 (PDF card: 38-0419) and (011) lattice planes of Ni (PDF card: 04-0850). Besides, the peak at 51.6° is well defined and can be assigned to the (200) lattice plane of FeNi3, confirming the phase purity of the as-prepared films on SLS.
